decision.name: TWO_WRITER_THREE_OUTPUT_CONSUMER_SNAPSHOT_ACCEPTANCE
decision.finding: Archive lock now serializes observation read/write, but runner.run_once still publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, and anata_latest.json via three independent atomic_write_json calls. A consumer reading the trio can observe mixed generations, and two successful runs can leave persistent mixed generations. This is source-derived; no known production consumer of all three and no confirmed incident.
decision.improvement_over_pinned: Add a pre-seeded generation S and explicit consumer snapshot while writer A is paused after latest.json, proving a transient torn read as well as pinned persistent torn final state. Keep monkeypatch thread-scoped to writer A; collect all snapshots and assert only after finally cleanup, so RED test cannot strand writer.
runnable_contract: Add test-only part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py on an isolated checkout of EXACT public SHA; do not change production code. Use tmp_path, append_observations once with pinned valid BTC ETF row; network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms explicit.
Seed run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=False,as_of_ms=1800000000000) to publish S; assert all three top-level as_of_ms==S and archive contains one unchanged observation.

Monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json with original forwarding. Only for thread named writer-A AND path.name=='latest.json': invoke original first, set A_paused Event, then wait release_A Event with bounded timeout. Start writer-A at 1800000060000; assert A_paused.wait(10).

While A paused, read all three JSON files and record transient snapshot (predicted A,S,S). Start writer-B at 1800000120000 on same local_dir; join B with timeout 10, assert completed without exception; record snapshot (predicted B,B,B).

In finally release_A, join both with bounded timeouts and assert no live thread; record final snapshot (predicted B,A,A). Assert both runs succeeded, appended_observations==0, archive still one original ID/clock/provenance; JSON loads for every file.

Acceptance assertions require every observed snapshot to contain one identical as_of_ms across latest/audit/anata, including transient and final. Baseline current source predicts RED, not executed. Run sequential C at 1800000180000 afterward and assert all three C and archive unchanged (positive control).
Targeted: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py; full: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests; capture exit codes and exact SHA. No network calls.
decision.additional_integration_gate: ArchiveWriterLock uses PID-only orphan .lock and cannot safely auto-reap; require operator-only fail-closed recovery with proof no live owner and validated archive JSONL integrity before manual lock removal. Do not auto-delete.
decision.next_feasible_recovery: Provide authorized isolated exact-SHA checkout/runner; execute baseline RED and full suite, then allow Gemini-only narrow fix after structured-JSON reliability proven and queue empty. Independent C verification and fresh Supervisor PLATEAU required for promotion.
